before.html:
Question 1
?

The initial velocity of a particle is (5i+3j)m/s. Find the speed of the particle after 3 seconds if the particle moves with a constant acceleration of (−i+2j)m/s2. Round your answer to two decimal places.

a
10.12m/s
b
9.45m/s
c
8.77m/s
d
8.34m/s
e
9.22m/s
Submit

decision.explanation: After 3 seconds, v=(5,3)+3(-1,2)=(2,9) m/s. The speed is |v|=√(2²+9²)=√85≈9.22 m/s.

after.name: Question 1
after.problem: The initial velocity of a particle is $(5i+3j)\,\text{m/s}.$ Find the speed of the particle after $3$ seconds if the particle moves with a constant acceleration of $(-i+2j)\,{\text{m/s}}^{2}.$ Round your answer to two decimal places.
after.worked_solution:
Recall that when a particle moves with constant acceleration, the velocity vector at time $t$ can be found using

$$
v=u+at,
$$

where $u$ is the initial velocity, and $a$ is the acceleration of the particle.

Here, we have

$$
u=5i+3j,\,a=-i+2j.
$$

Therefore, after $3$ seconds, the velocity of the particle will be

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =u+at \\  & =(5i+3j)+(-i+2j)(3) \\  & =(5i+3j)+(-3i+6j) \\  & =(2i+9j)\,\text{m/s}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, the speed of the particle is

$$
\begin{aligned}|v| & =|2i+9j| \\  & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+{9}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{4+81} \\  & =\sqrt{85} \\  & ≈9.22\,\text{m/s}\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to two decimal places.

Question 1
?

The initial velocity of a particle is (5i+3j)m/s. Find the speed of the particle after 3 seconds if the particle moves with a constant acceleration of (−i+2j)m/s2. Round your answer to two decimal places.

a
10.12m/s
b
9.45m/s
c
8.77m/s
d
8.34m/s
e
9.22m/s
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Recall that when a particle moves with constant acceleration, the velocity vector at time t can be found using

v=u+at,

where u is the initial velocity, and a is the acceleration of the particle.

Here, we have

u=5i+3j,a=−i+2j.

Therefore, after 3 seconds, the velocity of the particle will be

v=u+at=(5i+3j)+(−i+2j)(3)=(5i+3j)+(−3i+6j)=(2i+9j)m/s.

Finally, the speed of the particle is

|v|=|2i+9j|=22+92=4+81=85≈9.22m/s

rounded to two decimal places.

verification.explanation: The revealed solution confirms v=u+at=(5i+3j)+3(-i+2j)=2i+9j m/s. Its magnitude is √(2²+9²)=√85≈9.22 m/s, so option e is correct.

Recall that when a particle moves with constant acceleration, the velocity vector at time $t$ can be found using

$$
v=u+at,
$$

where $u$ is the initial velocity, and $a$ is the acceleration of the particle.

Here, we have

$$
u=2i+5j,\,a=-3i+j.
$$

Therefore, after $t=3\,\text{s},$ the velocity of the particle will be

$$

$$

Finally, the speed of the particle is

$$
\begin{aligned}|v| & =|-7i+8j| \\  & =\sqrt{(-7)^{2}+{8}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{49+64} \\  & =\sqrt{113}\,\text{m/s}.\end{aligned}
$$
